[[File:EchoRegManuals-Rookies.png|thumb|300px|Echo, reading one of the manuals]]
'''Regulation manuals''' were manuals given to, and read by, [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]]. They dealt with standard regulations among the troopers. At least one regulation stated within the manual covered what to do if [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|the sergeant]] of a unit was rendered unavailable, with [[Echo/Legends|Echo]] attempting to read it when [[Fives/Legends|Fives]] asked what they are to do before being cut off.<ref name="Rookies" />
